market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to consolidate lower in 1-3 month window. Rate-rise fears, oil spike, and iron ore weakness create headwinds. RBA rental-inflation commentary keeps markets on edge. Expect 3-5% further downside risk before stabilisation. AUD likely to trade softer, amplifying import-cost inflation.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pivots to cuts by mid-2027. Housing correction may stabilise with first-home-buyer surge. Energy transition and AI infrastructure capex provide structural tailwinds. Iron ore recovery contingent on China stimulus. Superannuation reform could unlock long-term capital flows.
